placement_override.why: planner/deploy/base.py::resolve_devices maps an island to ALL of its accelerator ids, so heteropilot names a TEMPLATE and cannot name a PLACEMENT. T2 is the placement under test: PCIe across the host bridge, measured 25.12 GB/s p2p.

scope_cut.why: the topology condition places this many devices, so the planner was asked for the best plan of that size. Larger plans were not considered -- not considered and rejected (GS-27).
